privacy.note: Only charging-infrastructure facts transcribed from user-verified app screens/statements are stored.

modeling_rule: operator/CPO, site_brand, app_source/access_network, tariff_channel and status_source must be modeled separately. A roaming/eMSP app may expose a different tariff and a less fresh status than the native operator app.

observations.equipment_brand_evidence: EVGO branding visible on charging equipment/site photo displayed by EVOne
observations.tariff_interpretation: Do not treat 180 MAD/hour as EVGO operator-direct pricing unless confirmed in the EVGO native app/API. It is currently an EVOne-displayed access/roaming tariff.

observations.user_observation: EVOne showed Marjane Mohammedia as offline/unavailable while the EVGO native app exposed connector occupancy/session state and the charge-start workflow.
observations.assessment: EVOne station/status data may be cached, delayed, incomplete or sourced from a roaming feed with lower freshness than EVGO native data.
observations.modeling_consequence: Prefer native CPO/app status for live availability when available. Keep roaming-app status as a separately timestamped source rather than overwriting native status.
